sections.title: The Maya in Mesoamerica: The Development of Ancient Maya Culture within its Broader Regional Context
sections.description: This class offers both an introduction and examination of Ancient Maya culture and society reflecting the major new finds offered by recent research. Fusing archaeology, epigraphy (the decipherment of Maya writing), art history, and ethnohistory, with the emerging technologies of LiDAR, speleothem, and isotopic analyses, “The Maya in Mesoamerica” explores the development of a vibrant, distinctive, and visually rich society, and how it fits into the wider history of a Mesoamerican region stretching from Mexico to Nicaragua. In including Maya inscriptions, we will be interested not only in etic historical studies in the present day but the emic voice of the only ancient American people to leave us a copious body of literature.
